findings_qualitative.value: Standard Gaussian PFA would give 104 (M1), 294 (M2) and 326 (M3) detections at the chosen threshold, hugely overestimating

claims.hypothesis: PFA alone is insufficient to judge reliability of individual detections; the SPFA does better
claims.experiment: Simulated map with 30 sub-noise sources; compare SPFA, least-squares fit and FDR
claims.result: SPFA predicted N_FD≈7 vs true 6; least squares gave six false detections; FDR gave a false fraction of 0.44 and 0.58
claims.finding: Only the SPFA quantifies per-detection reliability

evidence.quote: The conclusion is that only the SPFA is able to really quantify the true reliability of a given detection

claims.hypothesis: Faint point sources exist in the PKS0745-19 ALMA maps

evidence.quote: we highlighted the presence of $7$ potential new point sources (2 in M1, 3 in M2, and 2 in M3)
